activity.notes: Louis XVIII appointed Talleyrand foreign minister during the First Restoration. This Activity ends on 20 March 1815 at Napoleon's return to Paris; ATLAS does not bridge the Hundred Days as if Talleyrand continuously held a French royal ministry.
